data.label: Failed jobs
data.description: A change to a website, a database or a server did not complete.
data.subject: [{{brand}}] A change to {{website}} failed

data.label: Failed backups
data.description: A backup of a website did not complete.
data.subject: The backup of {{website}} failed
data.body:
Hello {{name}},

The backup of {{website}} did not complete at {{time}}.

The error: {{error}}

The earlier backups are not changed. Open the panel to make a backup now:
{{panelUrl}}/backups

data.label: Certificates that expire soon
data.description: The TLS certificate of a domain expires in 14 days or less, or the panel could not get one.
data.subject: Check the certificate of {{domain}}

data.label: Account suspended
data.description: The account is suspended, and its websites are stopped.
data.subject: Your account {{account}} is suspended

data.label: Suspension lifted
data.description: The suspension of the account is lifted.
data.subject: Your account {{account}} is active again

data.label: Sign-in from a new device
data.description: Someone signed in to your user from a device or browser that the panel does not know.
data.subject: New sign-in to {{brand}}

data.label: Usage alerts
data.description: A website, a database server or a mailbox uses almost all of its limit.
data.subject: {{account}} uses {{percent}}% of its {{resource}} limit
data.body:
Hello {{name}},

{{account}} uses {{used}} of {{limit}} ({{percent}}%) of its {{resource}} limit.
For: {{subject}}

When it uses all of the limit, changes can fail. A full mailbox refuses new mail. Remove data that you do not need, or ask for a larger limit:
{{panelUrl}}/alerts

data.label: Deploys that need attention
data.description: A deploy ran a database migration, and then the website failed its health check. The panel did not go back to the previous release.
data.subject: Examine {{website}}: the health check failed after a migration

data.label: Websites that are down
data.description: An uptime check of a website failed a number of times in a row.
data.subject: {{website}} is down

data.label: Websites that are up again
data.description: A website that was down answers its uptime check again.
data.subject: {{website}} is up again
data.body:
Hello {{name}},

{{website}} answers its uptime check again. It was down for {{downtime}}, from {{since}} to {{until}}.

Address: {{url}}

Open the panel to see the incidents:
{{panelUrl}}/uptime

data.label: Password reset
data.description: Someone asked for a link to set a new password for your user.
data.subject: Set a new password for {{brand}}
data.body:
Hello {{name}},

Someone asked for a link to set a new password for your user on {{brand}}. The request came from the IP address {{ip}}.

To set a new password, open this link. It works one time only, for {{minutes}} minutes:
{{resetUrl}}

A new password does not turn off your authenticator app or remove your passkeys.

If you did not ask for this link, you need not do anything. Your password does not change.
